_readme: Licence provenance for every image, video and vector asset shipped in prototype/assets. Created for the 2026-09 IP remediation (finding F-03). Every row must reach status "documented" (source + licence + proof, plus a model release where people are identifiable) or the asset must be replaced before public launch. scripts/check-asset-licences.py enforces this; run it with --strict as a launch gate.
